_comment: cadwiki-reload.json — place this file in your plugin's build output directory.
WHITELIST MODE: only DLLs matching 'include' patterns get version-rewritten.
All other DLLs (Newtonsoft, etc.) are copied verbatim. AutoCAD SDK DLLs are

_documentation.filterPrecedence: CLI args > cadwiki-reload.json > INI file > default (rewrite all)
_documentation.globPatterns: '*' matches any sequence of characters; '?' matches one character
_documentation.mainDll: The main plugin DLL is always version-rewritten regardless of patterns
